# The sample's mod lines (statdesc/testdata/item-lines.txt) that read in more than one way or
# whose text does not show a value, with the stats and values each should be read as, written by
# hand: item | line | stat=value, ...; the lines of one description joined with " / ". Armour
# and weapons take the local stat where the base rolls it; a stat with mods beats a retired or
# passive-tree one; a unique weapon's armour is global. An
# exact retired mod beats a current one the value is out of range for: the flask immunities "for
# 4 seconds" are the older fixed-duration mods (today's roll 6 to 17 seconds, and not on utility
# flasks), and the dagger implicit "30%" the older one (today's base implicit rolls 40 to 45).

unique Leather Cap | +35% to all Elemental Resistances | base_resist_all_elements_%=35
